```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(nlme)
library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(lme4)
```

Read in metadata
```{r}
# Load phenotype metadata
meta <- read_csv("../data/02-Physiology/Pairs_metadata.csv")
meta$ColonyID <- as.character(meta$ColonyID)
```


Read in PAM data 
```{r}
pam <- read_csv("../data/02-Physiology/PAM/PAM.csv")
pam$ColonyID <- as.character(pam$ColonyID)
```

Merge pam and metadata
```{r}
pam <- pam %>%
  inner_join(meta, by = "ColonyID")
```

Calculate mean and sem 
```{r}
pam_summary <- pam %>%
  group_by(Timepoint, Phenotype, Species, PAM_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_FvFm = mean(Fv_Fm_Average, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_FvFm = sd(Fv_Fm_Average, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem_FvFm = sd(Fv_Fm_Average, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Fv_Fm_Average))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Plot! 
```{r}
# Set levels 
pam_summary$Timepoint <- factor(pam_summary$Timepoint, levels = c("September 2023", "January 2024", "May 2024", "October 2024", "January 2025", "May 2025", "October 2025", "January 2026", "May 2026"))

ggplot(pam_summary, aes(x = Timepoint, y = mean_FvFm, color = Phenotype, group = Phenotype, shape = PAM_type)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_FvFm - sem_FvFm, ymax = mean_FvFm + sem_FvFm, color = Phenotype),
                width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.8) +  # color matches points/lines
  facet_wrap(~ Species) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Resistant" = "#4b294fff", "Susceptible" = "#f3a17dff")
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +  # bigger base size
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = expression(F[v]/F[m]),
    color = "Phenotype"
  ) +
theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 1),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "italic", size = 16),
    #legend.position = c(0.85, 0.83),  # adjust x, y for placement
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.7), color = NA),
    legend.key = element_blank(),    
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16)
  )

## save 
```
